claims: Álvaro Uribe Vélez was born on July 4, 1952.
Álvaro Uribe Vélez is a former president of Colombia.
Álvaro Uribe Vélez served as president of Colombia from 2002 to 2010.
Álvaro Uribe Vélez served two terms as president of Colombia.
Álvaro Uribe Vélez has faced long-standing legal battles regarding witness tampering and ties to paramilitary groups.
The Guardian reported that a 2025 conviction of Álvaro Uribe Vélez was overturned on appeal.
In August 2025, Álvaro Uribe Vélez was sentenced to 12 years of house arrest for bribery and witness tampering.
An appeals court overturned Álvaro Uribe Vélez's conviction in October 2025 due to structural deficiencies in the case, The Guardian reported.
The BBC reported that Senator Miguel Uribe died following a shooting.
